fieldValues.claim: The model must not presume who is in charge, who approves, or how a group is organised. Structure describes knowledge, never authority.
fieldValues.title: No engineered control hierarchy
fieldValues.explanation: Most collaboration tools quietly encode the structure of the organisation that built them: Conway's law made permanent in software. SRS is designed not to. Its structure comes from the knowledge being shared, not from a chain of command baked into the format. Relations are claims about knowledge, not control flow.
